text:
Pakhal Lake is a man-made lake in the Pakhal Wildlife Sanctuary in the Warangal district of Telangana, a state in Southern India.

--- Practical Travel Context (Wikivoyage) ---
Warangal is in East Telangana in Southern India. Historically known as Orugallu and also Ekashila Nagaram (City carved in single stone). Warangal is part of a tertiary city including Kazipet and Hanamkonda cities. The region once came under Kakatiya dynasty.
best_time: October to March (mild winter season avoiding summer humidity)
